notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. On-call handoff guidance: handoff components and timing, troubleshooting tips, and three Markdown templates (full shift handoff, async quick handoff, mid-incident handoff) with checklists.

The skill helps write handoff documents; it does not instruct the agent to run commands. The shift-handoff template's 'Quick Reference' block (references/details.md:149-161) lists example kubectl/psql commands and `redis-cli FLUSHDB` labelled 'emergency only' as content for the human reader; an agent should not execute it without the user's explicit request.

Related Skills links (SKILL.md:69-70: ../incident-runbook-templates/SKILL.md, ../postmortem-writing/SKILL.md) are optional sibling pointers that do not ship with this skill. No license field in frontmatter; covered by the repository-root MIT license.
